patch.value: GH-1072: pm install leaks user allow-scripts config into isolated package installs
GitHub issue #1072 reports that a non-empty user-level npm allow-scripts setting leaks into pm-owned isolated installs and makes npm reject an otherwise valid package despite --ignore-scripts.

Sanitize inherited npm configuration for pm-owned installs without weakening --ignore-scripts; cover npm and packed npx/bunx installs with an ambient allow-scripts negative control; return an actionable structured error for truly invalid package policy; preserve project/global package isolation.
Configure user npm allow-scripts; initialize a fresh tracker; install a valid packed extension through npx with --project; observe npm EALLOWSCRIPTS.
Package installation runs inside a sanitized npm configuration boundary while pm remains authoritative for lifecycle-script policy.
Ambient user allow-scripts reaches the subprocess and aborts the install before activation.
